735290102.text: Every step you take is overflowing with an intoxicating aura, as though you were performing a dazzling battle dance.

735290103.text: As the incandescent edge flashes across your face, the reflections in your eyes form a radiant golden flame...

735290104.text: As you dance gracefully around the forbidding fortress of ice, your steps weave an enchanting rhythm...

735290105.text: And as the wooden walls of cities come crashing down, or as you face down armies of iron giants, you nimbly catch every fleeting figure, even those that the fastest Kamera lens or pen could not hope to capture...

735290108.text: Such fervor and courage, what an admirable, indomitable spirit! No mistake, we are kindred spirits bound by destiny!

735290109.text: I am Lafeinte, the Blade Dancer. Might I be so bold as to inquire by which esteemed names you are known?

735290112.text: Paimon is well aware just how awesome we are! But Mr. Lafeinte, Paimon has no idea what you were trying to say!

735290113.text: Why call yourself the Blade Dancer? Paimon doesn't see a sword, and you don't look much like a dancer either...

735290114.text: Such an outrageous question! Surely Her Excellency Paimon is merely seeking to test my mental fortitude!

735290115.text: Rather than relying on the limited capabilities of a steel sword, the blade should be concealed in one's heart. When the time comes, your inner determination can be infused into any object, freeing your tactics from mundane shackles and restrictions.

735290116.text: Never care too much for the clothes one wears! The moment one steps onto the battlefield, victory can only be obtained and control maintained through one's graceful stances and elegant skills...
